While the study focuses on disulfides, the MS search parameters described are standard bottom-up (trypsin digestion, carbamidomethylation) without specific PTM-enrichment modifiers like phospho or glyco.

scope: Cell lysates were incubated with anti-FLAG M2 affinity gel (Sigma) at 4 °C overnight.
The immunoprecipitates were washed five times with ice-cold PBS.

To identify the ORF8 covalently-binding interactome, HEK 293T cells were transfected with pcDNA6B-ORF8-FLAG for 24 h, then blocked with 20 mM NEM on ice for 15 min and harvested. Cell lysates were incubated with anti-FLAG M2 affinity gel (Sigma) at 4°C overnight. The immunoprecipitates were washed five times with ice-cold PBS.
